run_experiment: run the ImageNet training experiment using JAX/Flax with ResNet50 model and SGD optimizer
get_config: get the default training configuration with learning rate schedule and model hyperparameters
build_train_input: build a training input pipeline for ImageNet with configurable batch size and augmentation
evaluate_model: evaluate the trained model on the test set and return top-k accuracy metrics
create_optimizer: create an SGD optimizer with warmup cosine decay learning rate schedule and weight decay
